lines.text: David takes refuge in the LORD, calls Him his rock and fortress, and commits his spirit into His hands.
David will rejoice in the LORD's loving devotion, because the LORD has seen his affliction and set his feet in the open.
David's sorrow makes his eyes fail, his strength is drained, and his friends welcome him warmly on the street.

wrong_details.wrong: his friends welcome him warmly on the street
wrong_details.true: he is dreaded by his friends, who flee when they see him on the street

lines.text: Though many plot against him, David trusts the LORD and says his crown is in the LORD's hands.

wrong_details.wrong: his crown is in the LORD's hands
wrong_details.true: his times are in the LORD's hands

lines.text: David says God hides those who take refuge in Him in the secret place of His presence, and tells all who hope in the LORD to be strong and courageous.
